pending_interview.question: You have a list of log entries, each represented as a pair: a user ID (a string) and a timestamp (an integer representing seconds since some epoch). The list is not sorted. You want to find all users who have at least one pair of log entries where the two entries are no more than K seconds apart. Write a function that returns a list of those user IDs. Walk me through your approach, the data structure you would use, the time and space complexity of your solution, and whether there is a more efficient approach if the input list is very large.
